description: A Perl script for managing and comparing configuration files, particularly in the context of kernel or software configuration. It includes functions for loading config files, setting and comparing configurations, and parsing expressions to handle complex config logic.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value in a config hash, with logic to handle certain special cases.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads a configuration from a file, parsing lines that set config variables.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Performs a logical AND operation on two config hashes, returning common settings.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two config hashes, with an option to modify the behavior based on 'mod_plus'.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Computes differences between two config hashes, with an option to filter new entries.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one config hash from another.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line or indicates if a config is not set.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Outputs the entire configuration, sorted by keys.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Recursively parses an expression representing config operations and evaluates it.
